notes.title: Steam Achievements!
notes.notes:
From now on, [i][b]El Virus[/b][/i] achievements are active. Will you be able to obtain all of them?

Additionally, there has been an addition of an advisory message to the previous animation regarding levels. These inform the player that a click must be made to continue.

Finally, an error that occurred when the player approached the class kids has been fixed.

Therefore:

[u][b]Added[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Advise of "Click to continue"
[/list]

[u][b]Fixed[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Class kids rotated when getting close to them
[/list]

notes.title: The Steam achievements has arrived to El Virus!
notes.notes:
[i][b]El Virus[/b][/i] is moving forward and is about to launch its Steam Achievements! Their design has already been completed, so it will be possible to unlock them in a few days. Are you capable of unlocking all of them while trying to survive in Yara's world?

Soon, after checking that everything works properly, the achievements will be unlockable.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
- The options menus have been fixed.

- Bugs that were present during death and restarting without quitting the game have been fixed.

- A skip option has been added to level introductions, making it easier and faster to re-game it.

notes.title: El Virus is here!
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome to the world of [i]El Virus[/i]! [/h1]

This new [i]Survival Horror[/i] will test your abilities to adapt to a post-apocalyptic world, where you will play as [b]Yara[/b], the great protagonist.


[h2]Can you survive?[/h2]


El Virus tells the story of [b]Yara[/b], a woman who wakes up in a hospital room, completely alone, in a post-apocalyptic world devastated by a new variant of the COVID-19 virus. Upon waking up, she will be obligated to figure out how to survive in an environment that is full of hostility and unpredictable dangers. Along with surviving, Yara is also concerned about finding her dog, Nala, and her partner, Denki.

notes.title: Screen Object Correction
notes.notes: Minor update to correct a bug that allowed users to [i]pause [/i]while picking up an object.
